item.title: Ruling Party Backs Jung Won-oh in National Assembly’s Public Administration and Security Committee… Oh Se-hoon Claims “Election Interference by the Government” (與, 국회 행안위서 정원오 지원 사격… 오세훈 “관권 선거”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Backs Jung Won-oh in National Assembly’s Public Administration and Security Committee… Oh Se-hoon Claims “Election Interference by the Government” (與, 국회 행안위서 정원오 지원 사격… 오세훈 “관권 선거”)

As the Seoul mayoral election tightens into a close race, the ruling and opposition parties are mobilizing all their party resources to go on the offensive against the opposing candidate. The Democratic Party of Korea raised allegations that Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, was aware of the “missing rebar” issue in the GTX (Great Train Express)-A Samsung Station section during his time as mayor but concealed it. The People Power Party countered, claiming the Democratic Party and candidate Jung Won-oh are spreading falsehoods. Candidate Oh brought up Jung’s activist background. (서울시장 선거가 접전으로 흐르자 여야가 당력을 총동원해 상대 후보를 겨냥한 공세에 나서고 있다. 더불어민주당은 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 시장 시절 GTX(수도권광역급행철도)-A 삼성역 구간의 ‘철근 누락’ 문제를 알고도 은폐했다는 의혹을 제기하며 공세를 폈다. 국민의힘은 민주당과 정원오 후보가 허위 사실을 퍼뜨리고 있다고 반격했다. 오 후보는 정 후보의 운동권 이력을 거론했다.)

On the 18th, the Democratic Party convened a full session of the National Assembly’s Public Administration and Security Committee to focus heavily on the missing rebar allegations. Lee Hae-sik, a lawmaker and the general election campaign chief for Candidate Jung, stated, “Candidate Oh clearly knew about the missing rebar but claimed on broadcast he ‘didn’t know,’ which constitutes a false statement under election law. Shouldn’t this be investigated?” In response to the Democratic Party’s request, acting National Police Agency Commissioner General Yoo Jae-sung said, “If a complaint is filed, we plan to proceed with an investigation.” When Democratic Party lawmaker Yoon Gun-young asked, “Candidate Oh said the poor construction was the fault of Hyundai Engineering & Construction (the contractor). Is that consistent with the facts?” Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung, also from the same party, replied, “This is an issue that requires first checking whether the Seoul Metropolitan Government properly conducted supervision.” (민주당은 18일 국회 행정안전위원회 전체회의를 열어 철근 누락 의혹을 집중적으로 거론했다. 정 후보의 총괄선거대책본부장인 이해식 의원은 “오 후보가 (철근 누락을) 뻔히 알고도 ‘몰랐다’고 방송에 이야기했기 때문에 선거법상 허위 사실 공표”라며 “수사해야 하는 것 아니냐”고 했다. 민주당 요구로 출석한 유재성 경찰청장 직무대행은 “고발이 있으면 수사를 진행할 계획”이라고 했다. 민주당 윤건영 의원이 “오 후보는 부실 시공은 (시공사인) 현대건설 과실이라고 했다. 사실에 부합하는가”라고 묻자, 같은 당 의원인 윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 “서울시가 감리를 제대로 했는지부터 점검해야 할 사안”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Park Soo-min argued, “The Seoul Metropolitan Government initially reported this to the Korea Railroad Corporation last November, and the Corporation is an agency under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. The Democratic Party claims it was ‘concealed for six months,’ but that’s false.” People Power Party members on the committee also stated they would file a complaint against Candidate Jung’s side for alleged false statements under election law, using terms like “Swiss cheese GTX” and “concealment” to criticize Candidate Oh. (국민의힘 박수민 의원은 “서울시가 철도시설공단에 지난해 11월 최초 보고를 했는데, 공단은 국토부 산하 기관”이라며 “민주당은 ‘6개월 동안 은폐했다’고 하는데, 허위 사실”이라고 했다. 국민의힘 행안위원들은 ‘순살 GTX’ ‘은폐’ 등의 표현을 써가며 오 후보를 비난한 정 후보 측을 선거법상 허위 사실 공표 혐의로 고발하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Candidate Jung held a press conference in front of Seoul City Hall that same day, stating, “The responsible party for construction and supervision is the Seoul Metropolitan Government, and its head is Candidate Oh. Candidate Oh must clearly disclose when he first received the report and what actions he took afterward.” He also blamed Oh for Seoul’s jeonse and monthly rent crisis and pledged to provide 200,000 won per month in rent subsidies to 200,000 young people. (정 후보는 이날 서울시청 앞 기자회견에서 “시공·감리 책임자는 서울시이고 그 장은 오 후보”라며 “오 후보가 언제 최초 보고받았는지, 보고받고 취한 조치가 무엇인지 명확히 밝히라”고 했다. 또 서울 전·월세난이 오 후보 때문이라며, 청년 20만명에게 월세로 매달 20만원씩 지원하겠다고 공약했다.)

Candidate Oh posted on Facebook, targeting the Democratic Party, “It’s not enough to stir up public anxiety by fabricating safety risks that don’t exist through fearmongering politics. Now they’re even mobilizing central government ministries and standing committees to attempt election interference by the government.” Regarding Candidate Jung, Oh commented on YouTube, “He served as the propaganda director of the National Council of University Student Representatives. It feels like he’s putting his youthful propaganda and agitation skills to use now.” (오 후보는 페이스북에 글을 올려 민주당을 겨냥해 “발생하지도 않은 안전상 위험을 조작해 국민 불안을 키우는 괴담 정치로도 모자라, 이제는 중앙부처와 상임위까지 나서서 관권 선거를 획책하려 한다”고 했다. 정 후보에 대해서는 유튜브에서 “그분이 전대협(전국대학생대표자협의회) 선전부장을 하셨다”며 “젊었을 때의 (선전·선동) 실력 발휘를 지금 하는 느낌”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Oh also brought up Candidate Jung’s past assault record, calling him “a person of character who can’t control his emotions.” He added, “Above all, the people around him are mostly Park Won-soon’s associates, and every policy or stance they put forward is just ‘looking toward Lee Jae-myung.’” (오 후보는 정 후보에 대해 과거 폭행 전력을 거론하며 “감정을 추스르지 못하는 품성”이라고도 했다. 그러면서 “무엇보다도 이분을 둘러싸고 있는 분들이 대부분 박원순 사람들이고, 내놓는 정책이나 입장은 전부 ‘이재명 바라기’”라고 했다.)

On the same day, Candidate Oh held a meeting with young people at the Seoul Youth Jobs School in Yeongdeungpo-gu alongside People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo, discussing AI-era youth employment. Oh said, “I plan to expand contact with those who can co-design the future with us, joining forces.” (오 후보는 이날 국민의힘 안철수 의원과 함께 서울 영등포구 청년취업사관학교에서 AI 시대 청년 일자리에 관해 청년들과 간담회를 했다. 오 후보는 “함께 미래를 설계할 수 있는 분들, 힘을 보태주시는 분들과 접촉면을 확대해 나갈 생각”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: "US-China Summit Confirms Goal of North Korean Denuclearization" (“미·중 정상회담서 北비핵화 목표 확인”)
item.description:
"US-China Summit Confirms Goal of North Korean Denuclearization" (“미·중 정상회담서 北비핵화 목표 확인”)

The White House stated on the 17th (local time) that President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping reaffirmed the goal of "North Korea's denuclearization" during their summit. Amid North Korean Chairman Kim Jong Un's steadfast refusal to engage in denuclearization negotiations, the US and China reiterated the denuclearization principles specified in UN Security Council resolutions. <<> That day, the White House released a "fact sheet" summarizing the outcomes of the US-China summit held in Beijing on the 14th, stating that "President Trump and President Xi confirmed their shared goal of denuclearizing North Korea." Although not a joint US-China statement, the mention of both leaders suggests, based on diplomatic norms, that prior coordination with the Chinese side likely occurred. <<> Experts suggest that the Trump administration, which launched airstrikes on Iran under the pretext of "preventing nuclear development," took a firm stance on North Korea's nuclear program to avoid accusations of a "double standard." In the fact sheet, the White House also noted that "the two leaders agreed that Iran must never possess nuclear weapons, called for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and agreed that no country or organization could collect tolls for passage." <<> South Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, "We appreciate the constructive discussions on the Korean Peninsula issue during the US-China summit," adding, "Our government maintains the goal of complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula and will continue efforts to achieve substantial progress in resolving the North Korean nuclear issue through close coordination with the US, China, and the international community." <<> ◇Faltering 'North Korean Denuclearization': US and China Reaffirm Principles <<> The Trump administration's National Security Strategy (NSS), released in December of last year, contained no mention of North Korea, including denuclearization. Similarly, China's white paper on arms control, disarmament, and non-proliferation, published in November last year, omitted for the first time any phrase supporting the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula. Amid Kim Jong Un's strong rejection of denuclearization talks, concerns arose that the US and China might shift toward "nuclear tolerance" or "disarmament negotiations." <<> Even after the US-China summit concluded on the 14th, China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs only stated that "the two leaders exchanged views on major international and regional issues, including the situation in the Middle East, the Ukraine crisis, and the Korean Peninsula issue." This was interpreted as taking into account relations with Iran, Russia, and North Korea. <<> However, three days later, the White House fact sheet confirmed a principled consensus between the US and China on "North Korean denuclearization." Professor Park Won-gon of Ewha Womans University said, "Given the concerns that the principle of 'North Korean denuclearization' might be wavering, it's a fortunate outcome that this principle was confirmed, even in a single line, within an official document from the US-China summit." <<> There are also analyses that the war in Iran is influencing Trump's approach to North Korea's nuclear issue. Professor Kang Jun-young of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies stated, "Since President Trump cited 'nuclear abandonment' as a justification for the war with Iran, he emphasized the principle of not tolerating North Korea's illegal nuclear weapons development on the same level." <<> Nevertheless, concerns persist that the White House fact sheet's mention of "North Korean denuclearization" may remain merely a symbolic, one-line rhetoric. The second Trump administration has yet to present concrete measures to achieve North Korean denuclearization. With a pileup of foreign issues such as the Ukraine war, Middle East tensions, and the Taiwan issue, North Korea has been pushed down the priority list. There is also limited room for China, which values its strategic relationship with North Korea, to strengthen sanctions or pressure to advance denuclearization. <<> Some suggest that if President Trump decides at any point that a meeting with Kim Jong Un is necessary, he may not adhere to the denuclearization principle. President Trump, during a phone call with President Lee Jae-myung on the 17th, reportedly recalled his past meetings with Kim Jong Un and expressed interest in US-North Korea dialogue. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 시진핑 중국 국가주석이 정상회담에서 ‘북한의 비핵화’ 목표를 확인했다고 미 백악관이 17일(현지 시각) 밝혔다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 비핵화 협상을 완강히 거부하고 있는 가운데, 미·중이 유엔 안보리 결의에 명시된 비핵화 원칙을 재확인한 것이다.)

item.title: The Reason YS Didn’t Attend His Eldest Son’s Wedding (장남 결혼식에 YS가 불참한 이유)
item.description:
The Reason YS Didn’t Attend His Eldest Son’s Wedding (장남 결혼식에 YS가 불참한 이유)

On September 25, 1982, YS marked the 22nd anniversary of his mother’s death. His mother had been shot in the abdomen and killed on the night of September 25, 1960, by two intruders who broke into their home in Oepo-ri, Geoje Island. This was an act committed by North Korean spies who had landed on Geoje Island and were hiding out, attempting to raise funds to flee to Japan. YS wrote, “How can such a thing happen in this world? The more I think about it, the more resentful and painful it becomes.” <<> On October 7, the wedding of his eldest son, Eun-cheol, was held at a wedding hall in Saegeomjeong, Seoul. The police chief and the intelligence chief came to inform him that he could attend the wedding. YS refused the offer and did not go to the wedding hall. This was because attending would make it appear as though he was living freely. <<> He said, “Unless the troops in front of the house are completely withdrawn and the guard posts dismantled, lifting the house arrest, I will not show gratitude to your dictatorial government, which is illegally detaining me while acting as if it’s granting me a favor.” <<> Today is the anniversary of the day 22 years ago when my mother passed away at the age of 52 from a spy’s bullet. Can such a thing happen in this world? Perhaps even a one-in-ten-million chance couldn’t produce such an event. The more I think about it now, the more resentful and painful it is. How wonderful it would be if my mother were still alive. I think any person is happy when they have a mother’s embrace to lean on. <<> My father came from the countryside, and my younger siblings arrived; we held a memorial service. My father and siblings all shed tears, recalling that time and thinking about the present, filled with regret. <<> These days, young university students are staging large-scale anti-government protests at every school. Many young students are being sacrificed. <<> Are those who are now condemning Japan’s brutal acts and Israel’s massacre in Lebanon really qualified to do so? What about the Gwangju Incident, and how many true patriots who love the country have been arrested and oppressed? Are they truly qualified to condemn others’ oppressive acts? <<> I read the Book of Isaiah once more. One of my favorite passages, chapter 41, verse 10: ‘Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, yes, I will help you; yes, I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.’ I will think on these words again and remember them. <<> Yesterday, it suddenly turned cold and rained quite heavily, but today it has cleared up. I haven’t written anything—what you might call a diary—for quite a long time. <<> That’s partly because there have suddenly been many people around during that time. When you’re used to being alone and quiet, a sudden change in environment makes that inevitable. <<> Eun-cheol’s wedding was held on October 7, Thursday, at 11 a.m., at the Saegeomjeong VIP Wedding Hall. The police chief and the intelligence chief came to my house two days earlier, on the 5th, around 10 p.m. It had been a long time since they last visited. Starting five days before the wedding, they parked a car right up against the front gate, and whenever our car tried to leave, they would open the trunk to check it, then move the car aside only after inspection. This was to prevent me from possibly sneaking out in the trunk. <<> Of course, I have no intention of sneaking out in the trunk in any case. The police chief came and said to me, “Tomorrow and the day after, we will allow people to come and go freely, and you, Chairman, can also go out freely.” Of course, in reality, not everyone could come and go freely. I made it clear to them: unless the troops in front of the house are completely withdrawn and the guard posts dismantled, lifting the house arrest starting tomorrow, I will not show any gratitude to your dictatorial government, which is illegally detaining me while acting as if it’s granting me a favor. I also told them that although the dictatorship is using bayonets and guns to keep me confined and propagandizing as if stability has come and the world is doing well, they should know that dictatorial regimes perish, and they should fear the heavens, history, and the people. Of course, I did not attend the wedding. I hear about 4,000 people attended to congratulate. After the wedding, over 500 people swarmed the house. At first, the dictator’s henchmen blocked them, but in the end, they couldn’t stop them. They poured in like a tidal wave. <<> In the yard, I gave them a speech. “I really am glad to see you all. In this gathering, there are comrades I haven’t met in years. Today is my eldest son’s wedding. I am human too—wouldn’t I want to attend my eldest son’s wedding? The night before last, when the police chief came, I told him this: The dictatorial regime may lock me up, place me under house arrest, shoot me with guns, or do as it pleases with violence, but it cannot take away my heart. As Zhuangzi said, ‘There is no greater sorrow than the death of the heart.’ If there is the saddest thing in the world, it is when the heart dies—I think that is the most fitting saying. I was once the chairman of the opposition party and a man who aimed to become the president of this country. But at this moment, I have no greed for power. This is the truth. I would only be happy to share honor and disgrace with the people. What is the point of living to 90, 80, or 70? I think living with dignity and value is what matters most. I believe we must not take the path of dying forever just to live for a fleeting moment. Everyone, please stay healthy, and let us firmly believe that in the not-too-distant future, an era of democracy with hope and aspiration will surely come.” I spoke roughly along these lines. <<> From the 8th onward, of course, they closed off access again, so no one could come in. <<> Since Hye-yeong and Gwon-oh came from the U.S., these past few days have been joyful with Gwon-oh, but also half filled with quarrels. <<> Let me try to make a habit of writing a diary every day as much as possible! I don’t know how long the house arrest will continue, but let me live a systematic life every day. <<> Every morning, I jog for 40 to 50 minutes or ride a bicycle. A person cannot live like an animal just by eating. <<> Reading books is a joy. Practicing calligraphy is a joy and brings mental cultivation. Today, I was deeply impressed by a piece titled ‘MacArthur and Yoshida’ from a book by Nixon, ‘Postwar World and Personalities.’ <<> MacArthur was called a hero with innate insight. <<> After being dismissed as Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, who said, “Old soldiers never die, they just fade away,” Nixon remarked about his speech to the joint session of Congress: “It was so great that no one, including the president, could match it. Some congressmen said they heard the voice of God. Another senator said MacArthur’s speech moistened the eyes of Republican members and wet the pants of Democratic members.” He was a great figure. <<> Today’s newspaper also reported that the Minister of Justice announced that Park Gwan-hyeon, the former student council president of Chonnam National University who died at Gwangju Prison, did not die from starvation. Who in this land would believe that as the truth? No matter how much the dictatorial regime oppresses, democracy, which our people yearn for, will surely come. (YS는 1982년 9월 25일 어머니 22주기를 맞았습니다. YS의 어머니는 1960년 9월 25일 밤 거제도 외포리 집에 들어온 괴한 둘에게 복부 총상을 입고 사망했습니다. 북한 간첩이 거제도에 상륙해 숨어지내다가 일본 밀항을 위해 자금을 마련하려고 벌인 일이었습니다. YS는 “세상에 이런 일도 있을 수 있을까. 생각하면 생각할수록 분하고 괴로운 일이다”라고 적었습니다.)

item.title: [Plaza] Recipients of the 3rd Baekbong Korean Peninsula Culture Award and Others ([플라자] 제3회 백봉 한반도 문화상 수상자 외)
item.description:
[Plaza] Recipients of the 3rd Baekbong Korean Peninsula Culture Award and Others ([플라자] 제3회 백봉 한반도 문화상 수상자 외)

▲The Baekbong Political Culture and Education Research Institute (Chairman Ra Jong-il) has selected Kim Tae-young and Shim Young-mi, professors at Kyung Hee University who serve as the chair and vice-chair, respectively, of the Korean Association for Public Administration’s North-South Integration Culture Steering Committee, as co-recipients of the 3rd Baekbong Korean Peninsula Culture Award. The award ceremony will be held on the 21st at 3 p.m. in the Hallasan Room of the Seoul Club in Jangchung-dong, Seoul. (▲백봉정치문화교육연구원(이사장 라종일)은 제3회 백봉 한반도 문화상 공동 수상자로 한국행정학회 남북통합문화운영위원회 위원장과 부위원장을 각각 맡고 있는 김태영·심영미 경희대 교수를 선정했다. 시상식은 오는 21일 오후 3시 서울 장충동 서울클럽 한라산 룸에서 열린다.)

▲The National Pension Service announced on the 18th that it donated 100 million won to Save the Children through ‘Dream-Tree,’ a social contribution activity involving employee participation. A total of 1,207 employees of the service participated in this step-based donation campaign held over the past month, walking 233 million steps, exceeding the target of 200 million steps. (▲국민연금공단은 임직원 참여형 사회공헌 활동인 ‘꿈틀이(Dream-Tree)’를 통해 세이브더칠드런에 1억원을 후원했다고 18일 밝혔다. 지난 한 달간 진행한 이 걸음 기부 활동에는 공단 임직원 1207명이 참여했고, 이들은 목표(2억보)보다 많은 2억3300만보를 걸었다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh Leads Among 40s and 50s, Oh Se-hoon Dominates 20s and 30s… Han River Belt Decides the Outcome (정원오는 4050, 오세훈은 2030서 우세… 한강벨트가 승패 가른다)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh Leads Among 40s and 50s, Oh Se-hoon Dominates 20s and 30s… Han River Belt Decides the Outcome (정원오는 4050, 오세훈은 2030서 우세… 한강벨트가 승패 가른다)

In the June 3 Seoul mayoral election, Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party are locked in a tight race within the margin of error, with a 3 percentage point difference, according to a survey by this newspaper. (6·3 서울시장 선거에서 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 오차 범위 내 3%포인트(p) 차이의 초접전을 벌이는 것으로 본지 여론조사에서 나타났다.)

In a survey conducted on the 16th and 17th by Matrix on behalf of the Chosun Ilbo, targeting 800 voters in Seoul (via wireless telephone interviews), Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh received 40% support, while People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon garnered 37%. Kim Jeong-cheol of the Reform Party, who has been mentioned as a potential unification candidate with Oh, received 1%. (조선일보 의뢰로 메트릭스가 지난 16~17일 서울 지역 유권자 800명을 대상으로 실시한 서울시장 지지도 조사(무선 전화 면접)에서 민주당 정원오 후보가 40%, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 37%를 얻었다. 오 후보와 단일화 가능성이 거론되는 개혁신당 김정철 후보는 1%였다.)

In a hypothetical two-way race for Seoul mayor released on the 12th of last month by Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea, Jung (52%) led Oh (37%) by 15 percentage points. The gap has narrowed by over 10 percentage points in about a month. Kim Seong-su, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Hanyang University, said, "The Seoul mayoral election, where Jung had a stable lead, is swinging as it turns into a contest of personalities." (지난달 12일 세계일보·한국갤럽이 발표한 서울시장 가상 양자 대결에서 정 후보(52%)는 오 후보(37%)를 15%p 앞섰다. 한 달여 만에 10%p 이상 격차가 좁혀진 셈이다. 김성수 한양대 정치외교학과 교수는 “정 후보가 안정적 우세를 보이던 서울시장 선거가 ‘인물 대결’로 가면서 요동치고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

◇ Jung Strong Among 40s and 50s, Oh Among 20s and 30s (◇鄭은 4050, 吳는 2030서 강세 )

By age group, the two candidates appear to be splitting support among specific generations. Jung led among those in their 40s (Jung 51%, Oh 28%) and 50s (Jung 60%, Oh 25%) by roughly double. Among those in their 60s, Jung also led Oh within the margin of error (45% to 40%). (연령별로 보면, 두 후보는 특정 세대의 지지를 나눠 가지는 것으로 나타났다. 정 후보는 40대(정 후보 51%, 오 후보 28%)와 50대(정 후보 60%, 오 후보 25%)에서 두 배 안팎의 차이로 앞섰다. 60대에서도 정 후보는 오 후보에게 오차 범위 내에서 앞서는 것(45% 대 40%)으로 조사됐다.)

Conversely, Oh showed a clear lead outside the margin of error among those in their 20s (Oh 36%, Jung 20%), 30s (Oh 40%, Jung 32%), and 70s and older (Oh 55%, Jung 29%). (반대로 오 후보는 20대(오 후보 36%, 정 후보 20%), 30대(오 후보 40%, 정 후보 32%), 70대 이상(오 후보 55%, 정 후보 29%)에서 고르게 오차 범위 밖의 우세를 보였다.)

Voter turnout is being cited as a late-stage variable that could decide the Seoul mayoral race. In this survey, the highest rate of "definitely will vote" responses came from those aged 70 and over (90%). Age groups where Jung leads—those in their 40s (77%), 50s (83%), and 60s (88%)—also showed strong intentions to vote. (투표율은 서울시장 선거의 승패를 가를 막판 변수로 거론되고 있다. 이번 조사에서 “반드시 투표하겠다”라고 응답한 세대는 70대 이상(90%)이 가장 높았다. 정 후보가 우세인 40대(77%), 50대(83%), 60대(88%)도 적극적인 투표 의사를 나타냈다.)

In contrast, among the 20s (53%) and 30s (64%) where Oh leads, the willingness to vote was relatively lower, which is expected to act as a future variable. Analysts suggest this is not unrelated to Oh's focus on housing, employment, welfare, and AI pledges targeting younger voters. A People Power Party Seoul party official said, "That's also why we are seeking a candidate merger with the Reform Party, led by Representative Lee Jun-seok." Meanwhile, Jung's camp is focusing on targeting the Han River belt, including the Gangnam area. Jung has announced policies such as reducing property taxes for single-homeowners with no income and shortening redevelopment periods, aimed at voters sensitive to real estate policy. (반대로 오 후보가 앞서나가는 20대(53%)와 30대(64%)에서는 투표 참여 의지가 상대적으로 낮아 향후 변수로 작용할 전망이다. 오 후보 측이 청년층을 겨냥한 주택·취업·복지·AI 공약에 집중하는 것도 이와 무관하지 않다는 분석이다. 국민의힘 서울시당 관계자는 “이준석 대표가 이끄는 개혁신당과의 후보 단일화를 모색하는 것도 그 때문”이라고 했다. 반면 정 후보 측은 강남 지역을 비롯한 한강벨트 공략에 공을 들이고 있다. 정 후보는 소득 없는 1주택자 보유세 감면, 재개발 기간 축소 등을 부동산 정책에 민감한 유권자를 위한 정책을 발표했다.)

In this survey, by Seoul region, Jung showed relative strength in the Gangbuk (north of the river) area, while Oh was stronger in Gangnam (south of the river). The region where Jung led outside the margin of error was the northeastern area (Nowon, Dobong, Gangbuk, etc.), with Jung at 45% and Oh at 36%. Oh led in the southeastern area (Seocho, Gangnam, Songpa, etc.) with 43% compared to Jung's 34%. (이번 조사에서 서울 권역별로 정 후보가 강북 지역, 오 후보가 강남 지역에서 상대적 강세를 보였다. 오차 범위 바깥에서 정 후보가 앞서나가는 지역은 동북권(노원·도봉·강북 등)이었다. 이 지역에서 정 후보는 45%, 오 후보는 36%였다. 오 후보는 동남권(서초·강남·송파 등)에서 43%로 정 후보(34%)를 앞서는 것으로 나타났다.)

In northwestern Seoul (Jongno, Seodaemun, Yongsan, etc.), the race was within the margin of error at Jung 39% versus Oh 36%, and in the southwestern area (Gangseo, Dongjak, Gwanak, etc.), it was Jung 39% versus Oh 34%. Polling experts said, "How Oh's approval ratings rebound in the Han River belt could determine the Seoul mayoral election." (서울 서북권(종로·서대문·용산 등)은 정 후보 39% 대 오 후보 36%, 서남권(강서·동작·관악 등)에선 정 후보 39% 대 오 후보 34%로 오차 범위 내에서 경합했다. 여론조사 전문가들은 “한강벨트에서 오 후보 지지율이 어떻게 반등하느냐가 서울시장 선거를 좌우할 수 있다”고 했다.)

In this survey, President Lee Jae-myung's national approval rating stood at 67% (29% very favorable, 38% somewhat favorable). However, regarding real estate policy, the biggest issue in the Seoul mayoral election, only 47% (15% very positive, 32% somewhat positive) said the Lee administration is doing well, while 44% (26% very poorly, 18% somewhat poorly) said it is doing poorly, contrasting sharply with the overall approval rating. (이번 조사에서 이재명 대통령 국정 지지율은 67%(매우 잘함 29%·대체로 잘함 38%)로 나타났다. 그러나 서울시장 선거의 최대 쟁점인 부동산 정책과 관련해서 이재명 정부가 잘한다는 답변은 47%(매우 잘함 15%·대체로 잘함 32%), 잘못한다는 응답은 44%(매우 잘못 26%·대체로 못함 18%)여서 국정 지지율과는 대조적이었다.)

Among the four regions in Seoul, the southeastern area, where Oh's support is strong, had the highest proportion of respondents (51%) saying the Lee administration's real estate policy is "doing poorly." Responses of "doing poorly" on real estate policy were next highest in the northwest (43%) and southwest (42%). In the northeastern area, where Jung leads, negative responses on real estate policy were relatively low at 41%. (서울 지역의 네 권역 중에서는 오 후보 지지세가 강한 동남권에서 이재명 정부의 부동산 정책에 대해 “잘못하고 있다”는 응답(51%)이 가장 많았다. “부동산 정책을 잘못하고 있다”는 답변은 서북권(43%), 서남권(42%) 순이었다. 정 후보가 우세인 동북권은 41%로 부동산 정책에 부정적인 답변이 상대적으로 낮았다.)

Yoon Tae-gon, director of the Deomore Political Analysis Center, analyzed, "Seoul citizens' dissatisfaction with real estate policy is combining with a focus on the individual candidate," adding, "Voters are starting to consider who has the 'gut instinct' to push forward Seoul's real estate policy." (윤태곤 더모아정치분석실장은 “서울 시민의 부동산 정책에 대한 불만이 인물론과 결합하는 양상”이라면서 “유권자들이 서울의 부동산 정책을 추진할 ‘감’이 되는 사람이 누구인지 고민하기 시작한 것”이라고 분석했다.)

◇ How the Poll Was Conducted (◇여론조사 어떻게 했나)

The Seoul mayoral election poll, commissioned by Chosun Ilbo and conducted by Matrix, surveyed 800 men and women aged 18 and over living in Seoul on May 16-17. It used 100% mobile phone virtual numbers provided by three telecom companies via telephone interview (CATI). The sample was proportionally allocated by gender, age, and region based on April 2026 Ministry of the Interior and Safety resident registration data, with weights applied. The margin of error was ±3.5 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 13.6% (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). <<>> (조선일보가 메트릭스에 의뢰해 실시한 서울시장 여론조사는 5월 16~17일 서울 지역에 거주하는 만 18세 이상 남녀 800명을 대상으로 실시했다. 통신 3사 제공 휴대전화 가상 번호를 100% 사용한 전화 면접 방식(CATI)으로 실시했으며, 표본은 2026년 4월 행정안전부 주민등록인구 기준 성별·연령별·지역별로 인구 비례 할당 후 가중치를 부여해 추출했다. 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.5%포인트였고 응답률은 13.6%였다(자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조).)

item.title: Jeon Jae-soo Leads Among Younger and Middle-Aged Voters... Gap Widens Beyond Margin of Error (청년·중년층서 앞선 전재수… 오차범위 밖으로 격차 벌려)
item.description:
Jeon Jae-soo Leads Among Younger and Middle-Aged Voters... Gap Widens Beyond Margin of Error (청년·중년층서 앞선 전재수… 오차범위 밖으로 격차 벌려)

In the elections for Busan mayor and South Gyeongsang governor, candidates from the Democratic Party of Korea are leading their People Power Party opponents outside the margin of error. In Busan, the gap once narrowed to single digits in the early range but has since widened again, while in South Gyeongsang, the difference has grown larger compared to a month ago. (부산시장과 경남지사 선거에서 더불어민주당 후보가 국민의힘 후보를 오차범위 밖에서 앞서는 것으로 나타났다. 부산은 한때 격차가 한 자릿수 초반까지 좁혀졌다가 다시 벌어졌고, 경남도 한 달 전보다 차이가 더 커졌다.)

According to a survey commissioned by The Chosun Ilbo from Matrix, conducted via wireless telephone interviews with 800 voters in Busan (response rate 13%) on the 16th and 17th, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo recorded 44% and People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon recorded 35% in the Busan mayoral election. The gap between the two candidates was 9 percentage points, outside the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). By age group, Jeon led Park among voters in their 20s, 30s, 40s, and 50s, while Park was ahead among those in their 60s and older. (조선일보가 메트릭스에 의뢰해 지난 16~17일 부산 지역 유권자 800명(응답률 13%)을 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화 면접 방식의 조사 결과, 부산시장 선거에서는 전재수 민주당 후보가 44%, 박형준 국민의힘 후보가 35%를 기록했다. 두 후보 간 격차는 9%포인트(p)로 오차범위(±3.5%p) 밖이었다. 연령별로는 20·30·40·50대에서 전 후보 지지율이 박 후보를 앞섰고, 60대 이상에서는 박 후보가 우세했다.)

The Busan mayoral election race has shown a trend where the gap recently narrowed then widened again. In a virtual two-way matchup survey conducted via wireless telephone interviews with 805 Busan voters by Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea on the 9th and 10th of last month, Jeon (51%) led Park (40%) by 11 percentage points. In a wireless telephone interview survey by News1 and Gallup Korea on the 10th and 11th, Jeon (43%) led Park (41%) by 2 percentage points. In this latest survey, the gap has expanded again to 9 percentage points. (부산시장 선거 판세는 최근 격차가 줄어들다가 다시 벌어지는 흐름이다. 지난달 9~10일 세계일보·한국갤럽이 부산 유권자 805명을 무선 전화 면접한 가상 양자 대결 조사에서는 전 후보(51%)가 박 후보(40%)를 11%p 앞섰고, 지난 10~11일 뉴스1·한국갤럽 무선 전화 면접 조사에서는 전 후보(43%)가 박 후보(41%)를 2%p 차로 앞섰었다. 이번 조사에서는 다시 격차가 9%p로 확대됐다.)

In the South Gyeongsang governor election, the Democratic Party candidate also showed a lead outside the margin of error. In a wireless telephone interview survey commissioned by The Chosun Ilbo from Matrix, conducted with 800 voters in South Gyeongsang (response rate 12.4%), Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo recorded 44% and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo recorded 34%. The gap was 10 percentage points, outside the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). (경남지사 선거에서도 민주당 후보가 오차범위 밖 우세를 보였다. 조선일보 의뢰로 메트릭스가 경남 지역 유권자 800명(응답률 12.4%) 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에서 김경수 민주당 후보는 44%, 박완수 국민의힘 후보는 34%를 기록했다. 격차는 10%p로 오차범위(±3.5%p) 밖이었다.)

Recently, the gap between the ruling and opposition candidates has been widening in the South Gyeongsang governor election. In a virtual two-way matchup survey conducted by Segye Ilbo and Gallup Korea on the 7th and 8th of last month, Kim had 44% and Park had 40%, a 4-percentage-point difference. (최근 들어 경남지사 선거에서는 여야 후보 간 격차가 확대되는 흐름이 나타나고 있다. 지난달 7~8일 실시된 세계일보·한국갤럽 가상 양자 대결에서는 김 후보가 44%, 박 후보가 40%로 4%p 차였다.)

In this Chosun Ilbo-Matrix survey, the party approval ratings in South Gyeongsang were Democratic Party 41% and People Power Party 36%. The support rate for Jinbo Party candidate Jeon Hee-young was tallied at 1%. By age group, Kim led among those in their 30s, 40s, and 50s, while Park was ahead among those in their 20s and those in their 60s and older. For details on each poll, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (이번 조선일보·메트릭스 조사에서 경남 지역 정당 지지율은 민주당 41%, 국민의힘 36%로 나타났다. 진보당 전희영 후보 지지율은 1%로 집계됐다. 연령별로는 30·40·50대에서 김 후보가 앞섰고, 20대와 60대 이상에서는 박 후보가 우세했다. 각 여론조사별 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam 25, Yoo Ui-dong 20, Cho Kuk 26… Intense 'Three-Way Race' (김용남 25, 유의동 20, 조국 26… 치열한 ‘3강 구도’)
item.description:
Kim Yong-nam 25, Yoo Ui-dong 20, Cho Kuk 26… Intense 'Three-Way Race' (김용남 25, 유의동 20, 조국 26… 치열한 ‘3강 구도’)

In the by-election for Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi, which is being contested as a five-way race, a survey found that three candidates—Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party, and Cho Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party—are in a close race within the margin of error. (5자 구도로 치러지고 있는 경기 평택을 재선거에서는 더불어민주당 김용남, 국민의힘 유의동, 조국혁신당 조국 등 3명의 후보가 오차 범위 내에서 접전을 벌이고 있는 것으로 조사됐다.)

In a poll commissioned by The Chosun Ilbo and conducted by Matrix, candidate Cho Kuk received 26% support, Kim Yong-nam 25%, and Yoo Ui-dong 20%. Following them, Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party garnered 11%, and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party received 6%. Those with no preferred candidate, undecided, or non-response accounted for 12%. (조선일보가 메트릭스에 의뢰해 실시한 여론조사에서 조국 후보는 26%, 김용남 후보는 25%, 유의동 후보는 20%의 지지를 받았다. 이어 자유와혁신 황교안 후보가 11%, 진보당 김재연 후보가 6%였다. 지지 후보 없음, 모름, 무응답은 12%였다.)

In the Pyeongtaek-eul district, party support stood at 48% for the Democratic Party, 24% for the People Power Party, and 7% for the Rebuilding Korea Party. Among Democratic Party supporters, voters were split between choosing Kim Yong-nam (47%) and Cho Kuk (36%). (평택을 지역 정당 지지도는 민주당 48%, 국민의힘 24%, 조국혁신당 7%였다. 민주당 지지층 안에서도 김 후보를 뽑겠다는 유권자(47%)와 조 후보를 뽑겠다는 유권자(36%)가 나뉘는 것으로 나타났다.)

By age group, Cho Kuk led among those in their 30s (41%) and 60s (27%), while Kim Yong-nam topped the 40s age group (38%). Among those in their 50s, Cho and Kim were tied at 29%. Yoo Ui-dong showed strength among voters aged 18–29 (33%) and those aged 70 and above (28%). By region, in the five eup/myeon areas (Anjung-eup, Oseong-myeon, Cheongbuk-eup, Poseung-eup, and Hyeondeok-myeon) adjacent to the West Sea and comprising urban-rural complexes, Kim Yong-nam led with 28%, followed by Cho Kuk at 26% and Yoo Ui-dong at 22%. In Paengseong-eup, Godeok-dong, and Godeok-myeon, Cho Kuk topped with 27%, followed by Kim Yong-nam at 23% and Yoo Ui-dong at 17%. (연령별로는 조국 후보가 30대(41%)·60대(27%)에서 가장 앞섰고, 김용남 후보는 40대(38%)에서 1위였다. 50대에선 조 후보와 김 후보가 29%로 동률이었다. 유의동 후보는 18~29세(33%)와 70대 이상(28%)에서 강세를 보였다. 지역별로는 서해 인접 도농 복합 지역인 5개 읍·면(안중읍·오성면·청북읍·포승읍·현덕면)에서 김용남 후보 28%, 조국 후보 26%, 유의동 후보 22% 순으로 김 후보가 강세를 보였다. 팽성읍·고덕동·고덕면에서는 조국 후보 27%, 김용남 후보 23%, 유의동 후보 17% 순이었다.)

In hypothetical two-way races assuming candidate unification, the pan-opposition candidate (against the ruling party) took the lead. If unified behind Kim Yong-nam, Kim would win with 47% versus Yoo's 29%. If unified behind Cho Kuk, Cho would win with 44% versus Yoo's 33%. However, pan-opposition unification between Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk has not progressed so far. Whether the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party, or the People Power Party and the Liberty and Innovation Party, will unite also remains a potential variable in the final stage of the election. (여야 후보 단일화를 가정한 양자 대결에선 범여권 후보가 앞섰다. 김용남 후보로 단일화할 경우 김 후보 47%, 유 후보 29%였다. 조국 후보로 단일화할 경우 조 후보 44%, 유 후보 33%였다. 다만 김용남 후보와 조국 후보 간 범여권 단일화는 지금까지는 진전이 없는 상황이다. 민주당-진보당, 국민의힘-자유와혁신 간 단일화 여부도 선거 막판 변수가 될 전망이다.)

◇How the poll was conducted (◇여론조사 어떻게 했나)

This survey was conducted on the 16th and 17th via mobile phone interviews targeting 500 adults aged 18 and older residing in the Pyeongtaek-eul electoral district. The response rate was 16.5%, and the margin of error was ±4.4 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. For details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee. (이번 조사는 16~17일 평택을 선거구 거주 만 18세 이상 성인 500명을 대상으로 무선 전화면접 방식으로 진행됐다. 응답률은 16.5%, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에서 ±4.4%p였다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae "I Am the Strongest Pro-Lee... There Is No Pro-Jung" (정청래 “내가 가장 강력한 친명… 친청은 없다”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae "I Am the Strongest Pro-Lee... There Is No Pro-Jung" (정청래 “내가 가장 강력한 친명… 친청은 없다”)

Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, claimed, "I am the strongest pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung)," adding, "There is no pro-Jung (pro-Jung Cheong-rae). The Democratic Party is all pro-Lee." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 “내가 가장 강력한 친명(친이재명)”이라며 “친청(친정청래)은 없다. 민주당은 다 친명”이라고 주장했다.)

In a Facebook post on the night of the 18th, Jung referenced a news article titled "The Ruling Party Requests Investigation into Alleged 'Jung Cheong-rae Terror Plot'... Conflict Spreads Between Pro-Lee and Pro-Jung Supporters," making these remarks. (정 대표는 지난 18일 밤 페이스북에 글을 올려, ‘與 “정청래 테러 모의” 수사의뢰… 친명-친청 지지층 갈등 번져’라는 제목의 한 언론사 기사를 거론하면서 이같이 말했다.)

On the 17th, the Democratic Party stated that it had detected signs of a terror plot targeting Jung and requested a swift investigation and personal protection from the police. This followed reports that posts such as "Let's kill Jung Cheong-rae" and "Recruiting Jung Cheong-rae assassination squad" appeared in a mobile messenger chat room. In response, Jung had previously said, "It’s heartbreaking and painful to think, 'Do we have to go this far?'" (앞서 지난 17일 민주당은 정 대표를 겨냥한 테러 모의 정황이 포착됐다며 경찰에 신속한 수사와 신변 보호를 요청했다고 밝혔다. 한 모바일 메신저 대화방에 ‘정청래를 죽이자’ ‘정청래 암살단 모집’ 등의 글이 올라왔다는 제보가 들어왔다는 것이다. 이에 대해 정 대표는 “‘이렇게까지 해야 하나’ 하는 생각이 들어 참담하고 마음이 아프고 괴롭다”고 했었다.)

The article that Jung referenced stated, "The controversy appears to be spreading into a conflict between the old mainstream supporters, leaning toward pro-Moon (pro-Moon Jae-in) and pro-Roh (pro-Roh Moo-hyun), and the hardline pro-Lee supporters," and noted that in the "Ddanzi Ilbo" bulletin board, where Jung's supporters are active, comments like "Prevent Jung Cheong-rae from showing his face at campaign rallies to weaken his influence over the party" appeared. Meanwhile, in an online community where so-called "New Lee Jae-myung" supporters are active, posts such as "Even without bias, it feels like a setup" and "They're jumping at the chance to blame the New Lee Jae-myung faction" have been surfacing. (정 대표가 거론한 기사는 “논란은 친문(친문재인)·친노(친노무현) 성향의 구주류 지지층과 강성 친명 성향 지지층 간 갈등으로 확산되는 모습”이라며 “정 대표 지지층이 주로 활동하는 딴지일보 게시판에선 ‘(유세장에) 정청래 얼굴을 못 비치게 하면서 당권을 약하게 만드는 (것)’이라고 했다. 반면 이른바 뉴이재명으로 불리는 지지층이 주로 활동하는 온라인 커뮤니티에는 ‘사심 없이 봐도 조작 느낌’ ‘이때다 하고 뉴이재명 소행으로 몰아간다’는 글이 올라오고 있다”고 했다.)

In response, Jung stated on Facebook, "I say this clearly. I am the strongest pro-Lee. There is no pro-Jung. The Democratic Party is all pro-Lee," and added, "Don't swing fists at empty air and try to sow division." (이에 대해 정 대표는 페이스북에서 “분명히 말한다. 내가 가장 강력한 친명이다. 친청은 없다. 민주당은 다 친명이다”라며 “허공에 주먹질하며 이간질하지 마라”라고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Highlights 'Insurrection Judgment' at May 18 Event Ahead of Elections (선거 앞두고 열린 5·18 행사서 ‘내란 심판’ 내세운 여당)
item.description:
Ruling Party Highlights 'Insurrection Judgment' at May 18 Event Ahead of Elections (선거 앞두고 열린 5·18 행사서 ‘내란 심판’ 내세운 여당)

The leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea attended the May 18 Democratization Movement commemoration ceremony in Gwangju on the 18th, once again advocating for an 'insurrection judgment theory' ahead of the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당 지도부가 18일 광주 5·18 민주화운동 기념식에 참석해 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 재차 ‘내란 심판론’을 주장했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung attended the 46th anniversary commemoration of the May 18 movement held at the May 18 Democracy Square on Geumnam-ro, Dong-gu, Gwangju on this day, stating, "Just like the citizens of Gwangju in May 1980 who stood against the martial law troops, the great people of South Korea in 2024 also blocked the armed martial law soldiers with their bare bodies." He added, "The grand unity of the world that blossomed in Gwangju in 1980 has been reborn as the 'Revolution of Light,' where people protected democracy through each other's warmth during the harsh winter night." He continued, "The spirits of May, reborn, saved the living on the night of December 3, 2024," and "The December 3 insurrection was an unfinished question from May." (이재명 대통령은 이날 광주 동구 금남로 5·18 민주 광장에서 열린 46주년 5·18 기념식에 참석해 “계엄군에 맞섰던 80년 오월의 광주 시민들처럼 2024년 위대한 대한국민도 무장한 계엄군을 맨몸으로 막아냈다”고 했다. 그러면서 “1980년 광주가 꽃피웠던 대동세상이 혹독한 겨울 밤 서로의 체온으로 민주주의를 지켜낸 ‘빛의 혁명’으로 부활했다”고 했다. 이어 “다시 태어난 오월의 영령들이 2024년 12월 3일 밤 오늘의 산 자를 구했다”며 “12·3 내란은 아직 끝나지 않은 오월의 질문이었다”고 했다.)

President Lee visited Gwangju on this day with his wife, Kim Hye-kyung. After the commemoration ceremony, they visited the newly reopened former Jeonnam Provincial Government Building. This building was the site of the final resistance during the May 18 movement, and its restoration began in 2023 due to citizens' demands, leading to its reopening. President Lee said, "I will make the former Jeonnam Provincial Government Building a sacred place of K-democracy, where citizens of the world can learn and remember together." (이 대통령은 이날 김혜경 여사와 함께 광주를 찾았다. 기념식 이후엔 새로 개관한 옛 전남도청을 찾았다. 옛 전남도청은 5·18 당시 최후 항쟁지로 시민들의 요구로 2023년 원형 복원 공사가 시작돼 다시 문을 열게 됐다. 이 대통령은 “옛 전남도청을 세계 시민이 함께 배우고 기억하는 K-민주주의의 성지로 만들어 내겠다”고 했다.)

Democratic Party representative Jung Cheong-rae also held a central election strategy committee meeting in Gwangju on this day, putting forward an 'insurrection liquidation' message to consolidate support. Representative Jung said, "The power to overcome the martial law insurrection came from Gwangju in May 1980," adding, "Without the May 18 movement, the June 1987 uprising, and the current constitution, we might have become crab bait in Yeonpyeong-do or been dragged to some nameless underground bunker, beaten to death and tortured." He continued, "There are still forces advocating for 'Yoon Again' and trying to reinstate Yoon Seok-yeol, the ringleader of the insurrection," stressing, "That's why May in Gwangju is not over, and the insurrection is still ongoing, a current event." Representative Jung declared, "In this election, we must undoubtedly judge the insurgent forces that plunged the constitutional order into crisis and write a history of victory that restores democracy." (정청래 민주당 대표도 이날 광주에서 중앙선거대책위 회의를 열고 ‘내란 청산’ 메시지를 전면에 내세워 지지층 결집에 나섰다. 정 대표는 “비상계엄 내란을 극복할 수 있었던 힘은 1980년 5월 광주”라며 “5·18이 없었다면, 87년 6월 항쟁이 없었다면, 지금의 헌법이 없었다면 우리는 연평도 꽃게밥이 됐거나 어느 이름 모를 지하 벙커에 끌려가서 죽도록 맞고 고문을 당했을지 모른다”고 했다. 그러면서 “(그런데 지금도) ‘윤어게인’을 외치고 윤석열 내란 수괴를 다시 세우려는 내란 옹호 세력이 있다”면서 “그렇기에 5월 광주는 끝나지 않았고 내란은 아직도 끝나지 않고 현재 진행형”이라고 했다. 정 대표는 “이번 선거에서 헌정 질서를 위기에 빠뜨렸던 내란 세력을 반드시 심판하고 민주주의를 바로 세우는 승리의 역사를 쓰겠다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party also highlighted that the constitutional amendment vote, aimed at including the spirit of the May 18 movement in the constitution's preamble, failed due to the People Power Party's boycott, which they labeled a 'hasty constitutional amendment.' Floor leader Han Byeong-do stated, "Due to the opposition of the People Power Party, the constitutional amendment could not be realized," and "The Democratic Party will promptly push for a constitutional amendment to ensure the May 18 spirit is included in the constitution's preamble." (민주당은 5·18 정신의 헌법 전문 수록 등을 골자로 한 개헌안 투표가 ‘졸속 개헌’이라는 국민의힘의 불참 속에서 무산된 점도 부각했다. 한병도 원내대표는 “국민의힘 반대로 (개헌이) 현실화하지 못했다”며 “민주당은 조속히 개헌을 재추진해 5·18 정신을 헌법 전문에 반드시 수록하겠다”고 했다.)

People Power Party representative Jang Dong-hyuk also attended the event. Jang entered the venue through a separate passage arranged by the organizers rather than the main entrance, facing protests from some citizens. From the People Power Party, Gyeonggi Province governor candidate Yang Hyang-ja and lawmaker Jo Gyeong-tae also attended. On Facebook, Representative Jang wrote, "Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party always champion the May 18 spirit, but for them, May 18 is not a value to protect but a tool for power expansion." He added, "The expansion of Supreme Court justices, the fourth-trial system, and the law distortion crimes pushed by Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party are unconstitutional evil laws rarely seen in normal liberal democratic countries," and "They are even tearing down the constitutional spirit to erase their own crimes." (이날 행사에는 국민의힘 장동혁 대표도 참석했다. 장 대표는 주 출입구가 아닌 주최 측이 마련한 별도 통로로 행사장에 입장했고, 일부 시민의 항의를 받았다. 국민의힘에선 양향자 경기지사 후보, 조경태 의원 등도 참석했다. 장 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “이재명과 민주당은 늘 5·18 정신을 앞세우지만 저들에게 5·18은 지켜야 할 가치가 아니라 권력 확장의 도구일 뿐”이라고 했다. 이어 “이재명과 민주당이 밀어붙인 대법관 증원, 4심제, 법왜곡죄 등은 정상적인 자유민주주의 국가에서는 찾아보기 힘든 반헌법적 악법들”이라며 “자신의 범죄를 아예 지우기 위해 헌법 정신마저도 무너뜨리고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee, on the same afternoon, posted on X (formerly Twitter) regarding Starbucks Korea's discount event under the name 'Tank Day,' saying, "On the anniversary of the Gwangju May 18 Democratization Movement, a 'May 18 Tank Day' event that insults the bloody struggle of Gwangju victims and citizens—this is outrageous." He also said, "I am angered by the inhuman and deplorable behavior of a lowly merchant," and "Corresponding moral, administrative, legal, and political responsibilities must be assigned." (이 대통령은 이날 오후 신세계그룹 스타벅스코리아가 ‘탱크 데이’라는 이름으로 할인 행사를 한 것을 두고 X(옛 트위터)에 “광주 5·18 민주화운동 기념일에 광주 희생자들과 광주 시민들의 피 어린 투쟁을 모독하는 5·18 탱크 데이 이벤트라니”라며 “저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장 행태에 분노한다”고 했다. “상응하는 도덕적, 행정적, 법적, 정치적 책임이 주어져야 할 것”이라고도 했다.)

Starbucks Korea held a discount event on a tumbler named 'Tank,' using promotional phrases like 'Tank Day' and 'Tap on the Desk.' This drew criticism for evoking memories of the military's use of tanks during the May 18 movement and the authorities' statement in 1987 regarding the death of martyr Park Jong-cheol from torture, where they claimed he 'tapped a desk and said 'ugh' before dying.' Shinsegae Group Chairman Jeong Yong-jin dismissed Starbucks Korea's CEO who oversaw the event. (스타벅스코리아는 ‘탱크’라는 이름의 텀블러 할인 행사를 하면서 ‘탱크 데이’ ‘책상에 탁’ 등의 광고 문구를 썼다. 이를 두고 5·18 당시 군부가 탱크를 동원한 것과, 1987년 박종철 열사 고문 치사 사건 당시 당국이 “책상을 탁 치니 억 하고 죽었다”고 발표한 것을 연상시킨다는 지적이 제기됐다. 정용진 신세계그룹 회장은 이벤트를 진행한 스타벅스코리아 대표를 경질했다.)

item.title: Seeking Cooperation in Ukraine’s Reconstruction… Could K-Construction See a ‘Second Middle East Boom’? (우크라 재건 협력 모색… K건설 ‘제2의 중동 붐’ 오나)
item.description:
Seeking Cooperation in Ukraine’s Reconstruction… Could K-Construction See a ‘Second Middle East Boom’? (우크라 재건 협력 모색… K건설 ‘제2의 중동 붐’ 오나)

Ukraine experts will gather at the 17th Asian Leadership Conference (ALC) at the Shilla Hotel in Seoul on the 20th and 21st to discuss the outlook for the war in Ukraine and the potential for cooperation with South Korea in the country’s future reconstruction. The war in Ukraine, which broke out in February 2022, has continued for over four years. Casualties on both sides are nearing 2 million. How to restore Ukraine’s basic infrastructure, devastated by the war, is a major global issue. The UN estimates that Ukraine’s reconstruction and recovery will require $524 billion (approximately 790 trillion won) over the next decade. (우크라이나 지역 전문가들이 오는 20~21일 서울 신라호텔에서 열리는 제17회 아시안리더십콘퍼런스(ALC)에 모여 우크라이나 전쟁의 전망과 향후 우크라이나 재건 과정에서 한국과의 협력 가능성에 대해 토론을 벌인다. 2022년 2월 발발한 우크라이나 전쟁은 4년 넘게 계속되고 있다. 양측 사상자가 200만명에 육박한다. 전쟁으로 파괴된 우크라이나 기초 인프라를 어떻게 복구할 것인지는 주요한 글로벌 현안이다. 유엔은 우크라이나 재건·복구에 향후 10년간 5240억달러(약 790조원)가 들어갈 것으로 추산하고 있다.)

At the session titled “Europe After Ukraine: A New Order of Security, Reconstruction, and Growth” on the 20th, Roksolana Pidlasa, Chair of the Budget Committee of the Ukrainian Parliament, will speak on the sustainability of Ukraine’s wartime finances. Chair Pidlasa has implemented budget policies under wartime conditions and worked to secure medium- and long-term fiscal sustainability. Vitaliy Kim, Governor of Ukraine’s Mykolaiv Oblast, who is of the fourth generation of the Korean diaspora (Koryo-saram), will also present on the current state of the war and future industrial recovery plans. Additionally, topics such as Ukraine’s accession to the European Union (EU) and prospects for the reorganization of the European order after the war will be discussed. (20일 ‘우크라이나 이후의 유럽: 안보, 재건, 성장의 새로운 질서’ 세션에서 록솔라나 피들라사 우크라이나 의회 예산위원장이 연사로 나서 우크라이나 전시 재정의 지속 가능성에 대해 설명한다. 피들라사 위원장은 전시 상황에서 예산 정책을 실행했고, 중장기 재정 지속가능성 확보를 위해 노력해 왔다. ‘고려인 4세’ 출신 비탈리 김 우크라이나 미콜라이우주(州) 주지사도 전쟁 현황과 향후 산업 복구 계획 등에 대해 발표할 예정이다. 이와 함께 우크라이나의 유럽연합(EU) 가입 문제, 전쟁 이후 유럽 질서의 개편 전망 등도 논의된다.)

At the session titled “Ukraine’s Reconstruction and Industrial Transformation: Korea-Ukraine Strategic Cooperation,” held on the same day, the potential for cooperation between South Korea and Ukraine in the reconstruction process will be addressed. Svitlana Kovalchuk, Secretary General of the Yalta European Strategy (YES) in Ukraine, will outline the current lack of infrastructure in Ukraine. Secretary General Kovalchuk explained to this publication late last year: “In Kyiv, electricity is available for only 6 hours out of 24, and the entire energy system has been destroyed.” (같은 날 열리는 ‘우크라이나 재건과 산업 전환: 한국·우크라이나 전략적 협력’ 세션에선 우크라이나 재건 과정에서 한국과 우크라이나의 협력 가능성을 다룬다. 스비틀라나 코발추크 우크라이나 얄타유럽전략(YES) 사무총장은 우크라이나의 인프라 부족 현황을 설명할 예정이다. 코발추크 사무총장은 작년 말 본지에 “키이우엔 하루 24시간 중 6시간만 전기가 들어오고, 모든 에너지 시스템이 파괴된 상황”이라고 설명했었다.)

To improve this situation, Ukraine is seeking comprehensive cooperation with South Korea. This could go beyond simply winning individual projects and extend to expanding mutual supply chains and technological collaboration. In the construction industry, some say, “Ukraine’s reconstruction could bring a ‘second Middle East boom’ to South Korea.” Lawmaker Yoo Yong-won of the People Power Party, Michael Kim, a foreign attorney at Kim & Chang Law Firm, and Tetiana Prokopchuk, Vice President of the American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine, are among those who will discuss this topic at the session. (이런 상황을 개선하기 위해 우크라이나는 한국과 전방위적 협력을 모색하고 있다. 단순히 개별 프로젝트 수주를 넘어, 상호 공급망 확대와 기술 협력에까지 이를 수 있다는 것이다. 건설업계에선 “우크라이나 재건이 한국에 ‘제2의 중동 붐’을 가져다줄 수 있다”는 말도 나온다. 유용원 국민의힘 의원, 마이클 김 김앤장 법률사무소 외국변호사, 테타냐 프로콥추크 우크라이나 주재 미국상공회의소 부회장 등이 세션에서 이 주제를 논의할 예정이다.)

item.title: Public opinion that "the withdrawal of the indictment in the 'Lee' case is inappropriate" is significantly higher in Seoul, Busan, Daegu, and South Gyeongsang (“李 사건 공소취소는 부적절” 여론, 서울·부산·대구·경남서 크게 높아)
item.description:
Public opinion that "the withdrawal of the indictment in the 'Lee' case is inappropriate" is significantly higher in Seoul, Busan, Daegu, and South Gyeongsang (“李 사건 공소취소는 부적절” 여론, 서울·부산·대구·경남서 크게 높아)

According to a survey, voters in Seoul, Daegu, Busan, and South Gyeongsang Province expressed higher rates of finding the "fabricated indictment" special counsel law, pursued by the Democratic Party of Korea, as "inappropriate" rather than "appropriate." In the case of President Lee Jae-myung's indictment being withdrawn through the special counsel, responses indicating it as "inappropriate" were also more numerous. The fabricated indictment special counsel law granted the special counsel the authority to withdraw the indictment in eight cases against President Lee, including those related to Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool. (더불어민주당이 추진한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법에 대해 서울·대구·부산·경남 유권자들은 ‘적절하다’는 의견보다 ‘부적절하다’는 의견이 더 높은 것으로 조사됐다. 이재명 대통령 사건이 특검을 통해 ‘공소 취소’ 됐을 경우에 대해서도 ‘부적절하다’는 응답이 더 많았다. 조작 기소 특검법은 특검이 이 대통령의 대장동·쌍방울 등 8개 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 권한을 부여했다.)

In a poll commissioned by the Chosun Ilbo and conducted by Matrix, the ratio of "appropriate" to "inappropriate" responses regarding the fabricated indictment special counsel law was 34% to 45% in Seoul, 28% to 49% in Daegu, 33% to 46% in Busan, and 38% to 41% in South Gyeongsang Province. (조선일보가 메트릭스에 의뢰해 실시한 여론조사에서 조작 기소 특검법에 대한 ‘적절’ 대 ‘부적절’ 응답 비율은 서울이 34% 대 45%였고, 대구는 28% 대 49%로 나타났다. 부산은 33% 대 46%, 경남은 38% 대 41%였다.)

In a survey on perceptions of the actual withdrawal of the indictment in President Lee's case, the ratio of "appropriate" to "inappropriate" responses was 32% to 51% in Seoul and 27% to 54% in Daegu. In Busan, it was 35% to 48%, and in South Gyeongsang Province, it was 38% to 45%. (실제 이 대통령 사건이 공소 취소됐을 때에 대한 인식 조사에선 ‘적절’ 대 ‘부적절’ 응답 비율이 서울은 32% 대 51%였고, 대구는 27% 대 54%였다. 부산은 35% 대 48%, 경남은 38% 대 45%였다.)

In the cases of Busan's Buk-gu Gap and Gyeonggi's Pyeongtaek-eul, where by-elections for National Assembly seats are being held, different patterns emerged. In Buk-gu Gap, 33% found the fabricated indictment special counsel law appropriate, while 49% found it inappropriate; regarding the withdrawal of the indictment, 36% found it appropriate and 54% inappropriate. In contrast, in Pyeongtaek-eul, 46% responded appropriately to the fabricated indictment special counsel law, while 39% found it inappropriate; for the withdrawal of the indictment, 45% found it appropriate and 44% inappropriate. A political source said, "The issue of withdrawing the indictment is expected to become a key issue in this local election." The Democratic Party, amid growing controversy over pursuing the special counsel law, has pledged to handle it in the National Assembly after the local elections. (국회의원 재·보선이 치러지는 부산 북갑과 경기 평택을의 경우 각기 다른 양상을 보였다. 북갑은 조작 기소 특검법에 대한 적절하다는 33%, 부적절은 49%였고, 공소 취소에 대해선 적절 36%, 부적절 54%였다. 반면 평택을은 조작 기소 특검법에 대해 적절 응답이 46%, 부적절은 39%였고, 공소 취소는 적절 45%, 부적절 44%였다. 정치권 관계자는 “공소 취소 문제는 이번 지방선거의 핵심 이슈가 될 전망”이라고 했다. 민주당은 특검법을 추진하다 논란이 커지자 지방선거 이후 국회 처리를 약속한 상태다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae's 'Pro-Jeong Candidate' Nomination to Blame? Democratic Party Suffers Approval Rating Drop in Honam (정청래 ‘친청 후보’ 공천 때문에? 민주당, 호남서 지지율 하락)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae's 'Pro-Jeong Candidate' Nomination to Blame? Democratic Party Suffers Approval Rating Drop in Honam (정청래 ‘친청 후보’ 공천 때문에? 민주당, 호남서 지지율 하락)

A poll released on the 18th showed that the approval rating of the Democratic Party of Korea has dropped significantly in its stronghold of Honam, just days before the local elections. The ruling party camp commented, "Noise surrounding the nomination of the Jeonbuk Province governor candidate and some basic local government head candidates in Jeonnam has led to a loss of support." The leadership of Jeong Cheong-rae plans to mobilize all party resources in Honam in the final stages of the election. (더불어민주당 지지율이 지방선거를 코앞에 두고 텃밭인 호남에서 큰 폭으로 떨어졌다는 여론조사 결과가 18일 나왔다. 여권에선 “전북지사 후보 공천, 전남 일부 기초단체장 후보 공천 등에서 잡음이 일면서 민심 이탈로 이어졌다”는 말이 나온다. 정청래 지도부는 선거 막판 호남에 당력을 총동원할 방침이다.)

According to a survey conducted by Realmeter on behalf of Energy Economy News on the 14th and 15th of this month, targeting 1,003 voters nationwide (wireless ARS), the Democratic Party's approval rating in the Honam region (Gwangju, Jeonbuk, and Jeonnam) stood at 57.2%. Last week, it was 71.5%. This represents a drop of 14.3 percentage points in just one week. The proportion of respondents in Honam who answered that they have "no supporting party" also increased significantly to 9.1%, up from 2.1% the previous week. Consequently, the Democratic Party's nationwide approval rating fell to 45.8%, a drop of 2.9 percentage points from last week. The approval rating of the People Power Party rose to 35.5%, up 2.6 percentage points from the previous week. (리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 14~15일 전국 유권자 1003명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(무선 ARS)에서 호남(광주·전북·전남) 지역 민주당 지지율은 57.2%였다. 지난주에는 71.5%였다. 일주일 만에 14.3%포인트가 떨어진 것이다. 호남 응답자 가운데 ‘지지하는 정당이 없다’고 답한 무당층도 9.1%로 지난주(2.1%)보다 크게 증가했다. 이에 민주당 전국 지지율도 45.8%로 지난주보다 2.9%포인트 하락했다. 국민의힘 지지율은 35.5%로 전주보다 2.6%포인트 상승했다.)

The biggest cause of the drop in approval ratings in Honam is analyzed to be the aftermath of the nomination process for the Jeonbuk Province governor candidate. With incumbent governor Kim Gwan-young expelled from the Democratic Party over the so-called 'proxy payment controversy' and subsequently declaring his candidacy as an independent, recent polls show a tight race between Kim and the Democratic Party's candidate Lee Won-taek. In local political circles, it is known that there is strong sentiment along the lines of, "While Kim was expelled due to the 'proxy payment controversy,' Lee received the nomination for being a pro-Jeong Cheong-rae candidate, even amid suspicions of paying for a meal on behalf of others." A key Democratic Party official said, "Sympathy towards Kim is spreading, affecting the overall election landscape in Honam," adding, "In addition to Jeonbuk, internal polls show independent candidates and those from the Fatherland Innovation Party performing well in basic local government head elections in Jeonnam, which is deeply concerning." (호남 지지율 하락의 가장 큰 원인은 전북지사 후보 공천 후폭풍 때문으로 분석된다. 현직 지사인 김관영 후보가 ‘대리비 지급 논란’으로 민주당에서 제명된 뒤 무소속 출마를 선언한 가운데, 최근 여론조사에서 김 후보와 민주당 이원택 후보가 접전 양상이다. 지역 정가에선 “김 후보의 ‘대리비 지급 논란’으로 제명당한 반면, 이 후보는 ‘식사비 대납 의혹’에도 친정청래계 후보란 이유로 공천을 받았다”는 여론이 강한 것으로 알려졌다. 민주당 핵심 관계자는 “김 후보에 대한 동정론이 돌면서 호남 전체 판세에 영향을 미치고 있다”며 “전북 외에도 내부 여론조사에서 전남 기초단체장 선거에선 무소속, 조국혁신당 후보가 선전하는 걸로 나와 고민이 깊다”고 했다.)

The Jeong Cheong-rae leadership has recently been increasing the frequency of its visits to Honam. At the vigil for the May 18 Democratic Uprising held in Gwangju the previous day, Jeong Cheong-rae was surrounded by civic groups protesting the nomination of the Jeonbuk governor candidate and was unable to move for a while. For Jeong, who is seeking a second term as party leader right after the local elections, losing in the elections in his stronghold of Jeonbuk would be a huge blow. (정청래 지도부는 최근 호남 방문 빈도를 늘리고 있다. 전날 광주에서 열린 5·18 민주화운동 전야제에 참석한 정청래 대표는 전북지사 공천을 두고 항의하는 시민단체에 둘러싸여 한동안 이동하지 못했다. 지방선거 직후 당대표 연임에 도전하는 정 대표로선 텃밭인 전북 선거에서 패한다면 엄청난 타격을 받을 수 밖에 없는 상황이다.)

item.title: 43% of Respondents Support People Power Party…Choo Kyung-ho, Trailing by 2 Percentage Points from Double-Digits (응답자 43% “국힘 지지”… 추경호, 두 자릿수서 2%p 차 추격)
item.description:
43% of Respondents Support People Power Party…Choo Kyung-ho, Trailing by 2 Percentage Points from Double-Digits (응답자 43% “국힘 지지”… 추경호, 두 자릿수서 2%p 차 추격)

The Daegu mayoral election appears to be a tight race between the ruling and opposition candidates within the margin of error. Early in the campaign, various polls showed Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum leading People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho by over 10 percentage points, but as the election approaches, conservative voters are consolidating, narrowing the gap between the two candidates. In particular, on the question of electability, Choo leads Kim, indicating a mixed battle. (대구시장 선거는 여야 후보가 오차 범위 내에서 접전을 벌이고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 선거 초반 각종 여론조사에서 더불어민주당 김부겸 후보가 10%포인트 넘는 격차로 국민의힘 추경호 후보를 앞서고 있었지만, 선거가 다가올수록 보수층이 결집하면서 두 후보 격차가 줄어들고 있다. 특히 당선 가능성을 묻는 질문에는 추 후보가 김 후보를 앞서면서 혼전 양상이다.)

According to a poll commissioned by the Chosun Ilbo from Matrix Research, surveying 800 Daegu citizens on April 16-17 and released on April 18 (telephone interview), Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum had 40%, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho had 38%, showing a razor-thin margin within the error range of ±3.5 percentage points. On the question of electability regardless of support, Choo led with 42%, 4 percentage points higher than Kim (38%). (조선일보가 여론조사 업체 메트릭스에 의뢰해 16~17일 대구 시민 800명을 대상으로 실시해 18일 공개한 여론조사(전화 면접 조사) 결과에 따르면, 민주당 김부겸 후보 40%, 국민의힘 추경호 후보 38%로 오차 범위(±3.5%p) 내 초접전을 보였다. 지지 여부와 무관하게 당선 가능성을 묻는 질문에는 추 후보가 42%로 김 후보(38%)보다 4%p 높았다.)

By region, except for Daegu's Dalseo-gu and Dalseong-gun, which include Choo's district, Kim led Choo in the central areas (Nam-gu, Seo-gu, Suseong-gu, Jung-gu) and the northern areas (Gunwi-gun, Dong-gu, Buk-gu). (권역별로는 추 후보의 지역구가 포함된 대구 달서·달성군을 제외하고 남·서·수성·중구 등 중부 권역, 군위군·동·북구 등 북부 권역 모두 김 후보가 추 후보를 앞섰다.)

The gap between the two candidates is steadily narrowing. In a survey commissioned by Segye Ilbo from Gallup Korea on March 10-11, Kim had 53% and Choo 36%, with Kim leading by 17 percentage points. A month later, a Gallup Korea survey commissioned by News1 on April 10-11 showed Kim at 44% and Choo at 41%, reducing the gap to 3 percentage points. (두 후보 간 격차는 꾸준히 줄어들고 있다. 세계일보가 한국갤럽에 의뢰해 지난달 10~11일 실시한 조사에서 김 후보 53%, 추 후보 36%였다. 김 후보가 17%p 앞섰다. 한달 후인 지난 10~11일 진행된 뉴스1이 의뢰한 한국갤럽 조사에서는 김 후보 44%, 추 후보 41%로 3%p 차까지 줄어들었다.)

Polling experts observed, "As the vote nears, conservatives appear to be consolidating, and recent controversies, such as the Democratic Party's push for a special counsel investigation into the alleged 'fabricated indictment' leading to the cancellation of the president's indictment, have had an impact." In the Chosun Ilbo's Daegu survey, 49% said the special counsel push was 'inappropriate,' while 28% said it was 'appropriate.' Indecisive or non-responses accounted for 23%. Regarding the cancellation of the indictment through the special counsel, over half (54%) deemed it 'inappropriate,' while 27% said it was 'appropriate.' (여론조사 전문가들은 “아무래도 투표가 가까워지면서 보수가 결집하는 양상을 보이는 데다 최근 민주당의 대통령 사건 공소취소를 위한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검 추진 역풍 등이 영향을 끼쳤다”고 봤다. 실제 본지의 대구 조사에선 49%가 특검 추진에 대해 ‘적절하지 않다’고 답했고 ‘적절하다’는 28%였다. 모름·무응답은 23%였다. 특검에 의해 공소 취소가 이뤄지는 것에 대해서는 절반이 넘는 54%가 ‘적절하지 않다’고 답했다. 27%는 ‘적절하다’고 답했다.)

Responses supporting 'the opposition to check the administration' stood at 44%, higher than 'supporting the ruling party to aid governance' at 40%. In party preference, the People Power Party led with 43%, far ahead of the Democratic Party's 28%. The Reform Party had 3%, while the Rebuilding Korea Party and the Progressive Party each had 1%. (‘정권 견제를 위해 야당을 지지한다’는 응답도 44%로 ‘국정 지원을 위해 여당을 지지한다’ 40%보다 많았다. 정당 지지도는 국민의힘이 43%로 민주당 28%을 크게 앞섰다. 개혁신당 3%, 조국혁신당과 진보당 각 1%였다.)

◇How the Poll Was Conducted (◇여론조사 어떻게 했나)

The Daegu mayoral election poll commissioned by the Chosun Ilbo from Matrix Research was conducted on May 16-17 targeting 800 men and women aged 18 and over residing in the Seoul area. It used a telephone interviewer-administered method (CATI) with 100% mobile phone virtual numbers provided by the three telecom carriers. The sample was extracted by allocating weights based on population proportion by gender, age, and region according to the April 2026 resident registration data from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety. The margin of error was ±3.5 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 13.3% (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (조선일보가 메트릭스에 의뢰해 실시한 대구시장 여론조사는 5월 16~17일 서울 지역에 거주하는 만 18세 이상 남녀 800명을 대상으로 실시했다. 통신 3사 제공 휴대전화 가상 번호를 100% 사용한 전화 면접원 방식(CATI)으로 실시했으며, 표본은 2026년 4월 행정안전부 주민등록인구 기준 성별·연령별·지역별로 인구 비례 할당 후 가중치를 부여해 추출했다. 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.5%포인트였고 응답률은 13.3%였다(자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조).)

item.title: Actor Lee Won-jong, Campaigning for the Ruling Party: "We'll Put an End to the Insurrection and Return to Our Main Job" (‘與 선거운동’ 배우 이원종 “내란 마침표 찍고 본업 돌아갈 것”)
item.description:
Actor Lee Won-jong, Campaigning for the Ruling Party: "We'll Put an End to the Insurrection and Return to Our Main Job" (‘與 선거운동’ 배우 이원종 “내란 마침표 찍고 본업 돌아갈 것”)

Ahead of the June 3 local elections, actor Lee Won-jong, who serves as the co-head of the Democratic Party of Korea's "Alley by Alley" election campaign committee, stated, "I plan to put an end to the insurrection through the local elections, help ensure the Lee Jae-myung government is well-established, and then return to my main job." (오는 6.3 지방선거를 앞두고 더불어민주당 골목골목 선대위원장을 맡은 배우 이원종씨는 “지방선거를 통해 내란 마침표를 찍고, 이재명 정부가 잘 설 수 있도록 해준 뒤 본업으로 다시 돌아갈 생각”이라고 밝혔다.)

Appearing on KBS Radio's 'Jeon-gyeok Sisa' (Lightning Current Affairs) on the 19th, Chairman Lee explained his decision to accept the position, saying, "There are still people in our society who support the insurrection, and if they are misinformed or misunderstand things, I wanted to meet them in person and talk it over." (이 위원장은 19일 KBS라디오 ‘전격 시사’와 인터뷰에 출연해 “아직 우리 사회에 내란에 찬성하는 분들이 있어 그분들이 잘못 알고 있거나 오해하는 부분이 있다면 직접 찾아뵙고 얘기를 나누고 싶은 마음”이라며 선대위원장직을 수락한 배경을 밝혔다.)

When asked, "You recently accompanied Gyeongbuk Province Governor candidate Oh Joong-ki—was it difficult?", Chairman Lee responded, "When I visited a few places in Gyeongbuk, including Pohang, I thought the opposition (conservative camp) might label me a narrow-minded person, but the way they treated me was really good. There were hardly any people who said, 'Why are you here? Just stick to acting, why are you doing this?' and got annoyed." (그러면서 이 위원장은 “얼마 전 오중기 경북지사 후보를 동행했는데 어렵지 않았냐”는 물음에 “포항 등 경북 몇 군데를 다닐 때 반대쪽(보수진영)에서 저를 편협화된 사람으로 낙인찍을 수 있다고 생각했는데 저를 대하는 느낌이 굉장히 좋았다”며 “여기 왜 왔어? 배우나 하지 왜?라며 짜증을 내는 분들은 거의 없었다”고 했다.)

He added, "Just one person politely grabbed my hand and said, 'Do your acting.' Other than that, everyone welcomed me very pleasantly." (그는 “딱 한 분이 점잖게 제 손을 잡고 ‘배우 해’라고 하더라”며 “그 외에는 아주 즐겁게 맞이해 주셨다”고 했다.)

Starting from the 21st, when the official election campaign begins, Chairman Lee plans to begin full-scale campaign support in tough districts at the request of the party. (이 위원장은 공식 선거운동이 시작되는 오는 21일부터 당의 요청에 따라 험지를 중심으로 지원유세를 본격 시작할 예정이다.)

Chairman Lee said, "The central party assigned four people to me along with a vehicle, and I think they’ll probably provide the gas money." (이 위원장은 “중앙당에서 네 분을 저에게 붙여줬고 차량과 함께 기름값은 주지 않을까 싶다”고 했다.)

Previously, Chairman Lee also served as a co-head of the Gyeonggi Province joint election campaign committee when Lee Jae-myung was a presidential candidate. He said, "At that time, I received 130,000 won per day. After multiplying by the official campaign period and deducting taxes, that’s what came out," adding that he expects a similar level of support this time. (앞서 이 위원장은 이재명 대통령 후보 시절에도 경기도 공동선대위원장을 맡았다. 그는 “그때 하루 13만 원 받았다. 공식 선거운동 기간 곱하기 한 뒤 세금 떼고 나왔다”며 이번에도 그 정도 수준의 지원을 받을 것 같다고 했다.)

item.title: Project Sariel: Intelligence Designed by Death (프로젝트 사리엘: 죽음이 설계한 지능)
item.description:
Project Sariel: Intelligence Designed by Death (프로젝트 사리엘: 죽음이 설계한 지능)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Outside Fallujah, Iraq, 2010. (2010년 이라크 팔루자 외곽.)

"It's awfully quiet today." (“오늘따라 엄청 조용하네요.”)

The sergeant in the driver's seat mumbled to himself. Evan didn't answer. (운전석 병장의 혼잣말이었다. 에반은 대답하지 않았다.)

It had been less than a month since he was deployed to Iraq. Today was his third mission outside the base. (이라크에 파견된 지 한 달도 채 되지 않은 날이었다. 오늘이 그의 세 번째 외곽 임무였다.)

Inside the desert-colored Humvee, gunpowder residue mixed with dust floated in the air. (사막색 험비 안은 화약 가루가 흙먼지에 섞여 공기 중에 떠다녔다.)

Evan stared out through the bulletproof glass from the passenger seat. The sun hammering the battlefield that day was searing, as if it would peel the skin from his flesh. (에반은 조수석에서 방탄유리 너머를 주시했다. 이날 전장을 내리쬐는 태양은 살갗을 벗길 듯 뜨거웠다.)

Eleven o'clock. A man burst out from behind a collapsed house. Brown dishdasha. A black bundle in his hand. Evan's hand moved to his M4 rifle. (11시 방향. 무너진 민가 뒤에서 남자 하나가 튀어나왔다. 갈색 디샤샤. 손에 검은색 뭉치. 에반의 손이 M4 소총으로 갔다.)

‘Enemy? Civilian?’ (‘적인가? 민간인인가?’)

The man raised his hand. Black object. RPG? Cell phone? Water bottle? (남자가 손을 들어 올렸다. 검은 물체. RPG? 핸드폰? 물병?)

Evan's index finger rested on the trigger. (에반의 검지가 방아쇠 위에 올라갔다.)

Is he definitely the enemy? (적이 확실한가?)

1 second. (1초.)

2 seconds. (2초.)

3 seconds. (3초.)

The man moved first. (남자가 먼저 움직였다.)

BOOM—! (콰아앙—!)

Behind Evan's vehicle. The third Humvee was engulfed in flames. The explosion, screams, and the smell of burning rubber hit all at once. (에반의 차량 뒤편. 세 번째 험비가 화염에 휩싸였다. 폭음과 비명, 타는 고무 냄새가 한꺼번에 덮쳐왔다.)

The heat of the blast lashed Evan's face. Tinnitus swallowed every sound. (폭발의 열기가 에반의 얼굴을 후려쳤다. 이명이 모든 소리를 집어삼켰다.)

"Contact! Contact!" (“Contact! Contact!”)

The driver yanked the steering wheel. Evan jumped out of the vehicle and aimed his rifle. Through the smoke, two men and an AK-47 came into view. (운전병이 핸들을 꺾었다. 에반은 차에서 뛰어내려 소총을 겨눴다. 연기 너머로 두 명의 남자와 AK-47이 시야에 들어왔다.)

This time, he didn't hesitate. (이번엔 망설이지 않았다.)

Rat-a-tat-tat. (타타탕—.)

One man fell. The other disappeared behind cover. (한 명이 쓰러졌다. 다른 한 명은 엄폐물 뒤로 사라졌다.)

"Medevac! Casualty evacuation!" (“후송! 부상자 후송!”)

Evan turned around. The third Humvee was nothing but a skeleton. He spotted someone collapsed beside the vehicle. (에반이 뒤를 돌아봤다. 세 번째 험비는 뼈대만 남았다. 차량 옆에 누군가 쓰러진 것을 발견했다.)

Sergeant Tanner. Twenty-two years old. From Tennessee. (태너 병장. 스물둘. 테네시 출신.)

"I'm getting married in June, sir." (“6월에 결혼해요, 소위님.”)

Evan first saw Tanner's severed arm, still wearing an engagement ring. Tanner's shattered eyes stared into the void. Something warm had already smeared onto Evan's combat uniform. (약혼 반지가 끼워진 채 잘린 태너의 팔이 먼저 보였다. 반토막 난 태너의 눈은 허공을 응시하고 있었다. 에반의 전투복엔 어느샌가 뜨끈한 것이 묻었다.)

His fingertips went cold. His breathing became shallow and rapid. He had been to a friend's funeral before. He had seen a sedan folded in half on the highway. But he had never seen someone die right in front of him. (손끝이 차가워졌고, 숨이 얕고 빨라졌다. 친구 장례식에 가본 적은 있었다. 고속도로에서 반으로 접힌 세단을 본 적도 있었다. 사람이 눈앞에서 죽는 건 처음이었다.)

Like this. (이렇게는.)

Because he was three seconds too late. (자신이 3초 늦었다는 이유로는.)

Last week, the image of Tanner holding out his fiancée's photo flashed through his mind. It was vivid—cupping it in both hands as if presenting the most precious thing in the world. Evan had nodded and said something in response. He couldn't remember what he said. (지난주 태너가 약혼녀 사진을 내밀던 장면이 떠올랐다. 세상에서 가장 소중한 것을 들어 보이듯 두 손으로 감싸 쥔 모습이 생생했다. 에반은 고개를 끄덕이며 무언가 대답했다. 무슨 말이었는지 기억이 나지는 않았다.)

Something rose from within. His hands began to tremble. (속에서 무언가가 올라왔다. 손이 떨리기 시작했다.)

Evan didn't wipe off the blood. He couldn't. (에반은 피를 닦지 않았다. 닦지 못했다.)

That day, Evan received the Combat Infantryman Badge (CIB). A decoration awarded only to U.S. Army infantrymen who have engaged in actual ground combat with the enemy. (그날 에반은 전투보병휘장(CIB)을 받았다. 적과 실제 지상 전투를 치른 미 육군 보병에게만 수여되는 훈장이었다.)

August of that year. Vehicle maintenance depot, US Eighth Army, Pyeongtaek. (그해 8월, 평택 미8군 부대 차량 정비고.)

After returning from Iraq, Evan was rotated to the Pyeongtaek base. The motor pool in August felt like it was being slowly boiled in the scorching heat. The humidity left by the monsoon blanketed the air like a wet cloth, making it hard even to breathe during outdoor work. (이라크에서 복귀한 에반은 평택 부대에 순환 배치됐다. 8월의 모터풀은 폭염으로 천천히 삶아지는 듯했다. 장마가 남긴 습기가 젖은 천처럼 대기를 덮어 야외 작업 중엔 숨을 쉬기조차 어려울 지경이었다.)

Evan was exhausted from performing PMCS (Preventive Maintenance Checks and Services) on top of a Humvee in front of the depot. The heat rising from the engine compartment choked him. Sweat dripped onto the blistering hot metal hull, sizzling and evaporating with a 'fizz' sound. (에반은 정비고 앞 험비 위에 올라가 차량 점검(PMCS)을 하느라 기진맥진한 상태였다. 엔진룸에서 올라오는 열기가 숨을 막았다. 뜨겁게 달궈진 금속 차체 위로 땀방울이 떨어져 ‘치익’ 소리를 내며 증발했다.)

The wrench tightening the antenna mounting bolt slipped from his sweaty hand. (안테나 고정 볼트를 조이던 렌치가 땀에 젖은 손에서 미끄러졌다.)

'Clang—!' (‘깡—!’)

A short, sharp metallic sound as it struck the vehicle body. (차체와 부딪히며 난 짧고 날카로운 금속음.)

That was the trigger. (그것이 트리거였다.)

In an instant, the Pyeongtaek maintenance depot's scenery flipped into the explosion scene in Fallujah. The smell of engine oil stung his nose. It was the smell of Iraqi blood. The damp Pyeongtaek air clung to his skin. It was the dusty wind of Iraq. (순식간에 평택 정비고의 풍경이 팔루자의 폭발 현장으로 뒤집혔다. 엔진 오일 냄새가 코를 찔렀다. 이라크의 피 냄새였다. 평택의 눅눅한 공기가 피부에 감겼다. 이라크의 먼지 바람이었다.)

His heart rate shot up rapidly. His vision narrowed. Tinnitus rang in his ears. (이내 심박수가 급격히 상승했고, 시야가 좁아졌다. 귀에선 이명이 울렸다.)

Rat-a-tat-tat. (타타탕—.)

Gunfire sounded from somewhere. Evan's knees gave way. (어디선가 총소리가 들렸다. 에반의 무릎에서 힘이 빠졌다.)

"Ugh..." (“윽…”)

He collapsed on the Humvee roof. Even though his cheek touched the scorching metal roof, he felt no heat. As his vision blurred, he saw the CIB badge on his chest glint. It felt like a defective inspection stamp on a faulty human part. (그는 험비 지붕 위에서 그대로 고꾸라졌다. 열기로 뜨거워진 금속 지붕에 뺨이 닿았음에도 열기가 전혀 느껴지지 않았다. 시야가 흐릿해지는 와중에 가슴에 달린 CIB 뱃지가 번뜩이는 것을 보았다. 마치 결함이 있는 인간 부품에 찍힌 불량 검수 마크처럼 느껴졌다.)

"Evan! You okay?" (“에반! 괜찮아?”)

He heard footsteps approaching. Evan couldn't answer even as he opened his mouth. (누군가 다가오는 발소리가 들렸다. 에반은 입을 열면서도 대답할 수 없었다.)

That summer, Evan's wrench kept dropping. In the mess hall, in the shower, in the fleeting moments just before falling asleep, it happened again and again. Whenever he heard the clang of metal against metal, the memory of Fallujah returned instantly. (그해 여름, 에반의 렌치는 계속 떨어졌다. 식당에서, 샤워실에서, 잠들기 직전의 찰나 속에서 반복됐다. 금속과 금속이 부딪히는 소리가 날 때면, 곧장 팔루자의 기억이 되돌아왔다.)

It was the specter of those three seconds. (3초의 망령이었다.)

Present day. Duadel Tech London Branch Office. (현재 듀다엘 테크 런던 지사 사무실.)

Evan had been opening and closing his desk drawer for days. Today, he finally took out an old velvet case. Pressing the sharp edge of the CIB badge inside the case with his index finger, he felt a sharp sting. (에반은 며칠째 책상 서랍을 열었다 닫았다를 반복했다. 오늘에서야 낡은 벨벳 케이스를 이번에는 꺼냈다. 케이스 안에 담긴 CIB 뱃지의 날카로운 끝을 검지로 누르자, 따끔한 느낌이 들었다.)

Why am I walking this path? (나는 왜 이 길을 걷고 있는가.)

He chose to be a commissioned officer because of Stanford tuition. The world he returned to after discharge was different. His close peers were writing ad optimization algorithms in Silicon Valley or stock trading algorithms on Wall Street. (학사장교를 택한 건 스탠퍼드 학비 때문이었다. 전역 후 돌아온 세상은 달랐다. 친한 동기들은 실리콘밸리에서 광고 최적화 알고리즘을, 아니면 월스트리트에서 주식 매매 알고리즘을 짰다.)

Around the time of his discharge, offers came from Silicon Valley too. (전역할 무렵, 그에게도 실리콘밸리에서 제안이 왔다.)

"We reviewed your resume. We were looking for an engineer with a military background, and we had no idea someone like you was on the market. We'd love to have you on our AI Responsible Technology team." (“이력서를 확인했습니다. 군 출신 엔지니어를 찾고 있었는데, 이런 분이 시장에 계실 줄 몰랐습니다. 저희 AI 책임기술팀에서 꼭 모시고 싶습니다.”)

And from Wall Street: (월스트리트에서도.)

"There's a position in algorithmic trading. Starting salary $250,000, signing bonus separate. Let us know when you're free for a call." (“알고리즘 트레이딩 부문에 자리가 있습니다. 초봉 25만 달러, 사이닝 보너스 별도. 편하실 때 통화 가능하신지요.”)

Evan turned them all down. Because they were worlds unrelated to Fallujah. Because to him, they were worlds where the meaning of work felt too trivial. (에반은 모두 거절했다. 팔루자와는 무관한 세계였기에. 내겐 일의 의미가 가벼운 세계였기에.)

Every time he said he was joining a defense company, his peers reacted the same way. You could go to Google, you know. His Stanford classmates looked like he was making a wrong first move. But Evan had already seen what three seconds of hesitation could take away. (방산 회사에 들어간다고 말할 때마다 동기들의 반응은 한결 같았다. 구글에 갈 수도 있잖아. 스탠퍼드 동기들은 그가 첫 단추를 잘못 끼우고 있다는 표정이었다. 그러나 에반은 이미 3초의 망설임이 무엇을 앗아가는지 본 뒤였다.)

What Evan couldn't bear wasn't the memory of the war itself. It was the fact that his three seconds had killed Tanner, and that those three seconds could be repeated somewhere else. Human judgment has its limits. Unless he created something himself to fill that gap, Tanner's name would never be erased from his mind. (에반이 견딜 수 없었던 것은 전쟁의 기억이 아니었다. 자신의 3초가 태너를 죽였다는 사실, 그리고 그 3초가 어디선가 반복될 수 있다는 사실이 견딜 수 없었다. 인간의 판단에는 한계가 있다. 그 한계를 채울 무언가를 직접 만들지 않는 한, 태너의 이름은 영원히 그의 머릿속에서 지워지지 않을 터였다.)

He realized it in Fallujah. Wearing a hoodie and headphones like everyone else, repeating meaningless coding—that was the path of forgetting and turning away from those three seconds. (그는 팔루자에서 깨달았다. 남들처럼 후드티에 헤드폰을 쓰고 무의미한 코딩을 반복하는 것은, 그 3초를 잊고, 외면하는 길이었다.)

That was why Evan chose the defense company Duadel Tech. For Evan, Sariel was not a 'product' to maximize Duadel's stock value. It was the perfect substitute to replace his judgment that had crumbled in the dust of Fallujah, and the masterpiece that would let his tragedy be forgotten. <<>> (그것이 에반이 방산회사 듀다엘 테크를 선택한 이유였다. 에반에게 사리엘(Sariel)은 듀다엘 주식 가치를 극대화하는 ‘상품’이 아니었다. 팔루자의 먼지 속에서 무너졌던 자신의 판단력을 대신해 줄 완벽한 대체물이자, 그의 비극을 잊히게 할 작품이었다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam Responds to Allegations of Assaulting Aides: “It’s True I Got Angry, but ‘Assault’ Is an Exaggeration” (김용남, 보좌진 폭행 의혹에 “화낸 건 사실, ‘폭행’은 과장”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-nam Responds to Allegations of Assaulting Aides: “It’s True I Got Angry, but ‘Assault’ Is an Exaggeration” (김용남, 보좌진 폭행 의혹에 “화낸 건 사실, ‘폭행’은 과장”)

Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the Pyeongtaek-eul district in Gyeonggi Province in the National Assembly by-election, said on the 19th regarding allegations that he assaulted his former aides: “There appears to be some exaggeration in the factual relationship. I even question whether calling it an assault is accurate.” (김용남 더불어민주당 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보는 19일 과거 보좌진을 폭행했다는 의혹에 대해 “사실 관계와 관련해 다소 과장된 측면이 있어 보인다”며 “폭행이라고 표현하는 게 맞는지부터 의문이 든다”고 했다.)

In response to questions on MBC Radio’s “Kim Jong-bae’s Focus,” the candidate stated, “It is undoubtedly true that I briefly lost my temper, but describing that as an assault seems somewhat off in terms of the facts.” (김 후보는 이날 MBC라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에서 관련 질문에 대해 “잠깐 화를 낸 건 틀림없는 사실인데, 그걸 폭행했다고 표현하는 건 다소 사실 관계에 좀 차이가 있는 것 같다”며 이같이 말했다.)

On the same day, a media outlet reported that in March 2015, when Kim was a first-term lawmaker for the Saenuri Party, he allegedly kicked the shin of a fifth-level secretary at a district event with his dress shoes while scolding him for inadequate preparations, among other acts of assault. (이날 한 언론은 김 후보가 새누리당 초선 의원이던 2015년 3월 한 지역구 행사에서 의원실 5급 비서관에게 준비가 미비하다고 다그치며 구둣발로 정강이를 차는 등 폭행했다는 취지로 보도했다.)

Kim said, “I wanted things done at my pace while working, and some aides may have found that difficult. If anyone was emotionally hurt, I personally regret that.” (김 후보는 “제가 일을 하면서 제 스피드에 맞춰서 오기를 원했고 그래서 어떤 보좌진은 그게 힘들었을 수도 있을 것 같다”며 “그래서 마음의 상처를 입은 사람이 있다면 개인적으로 안타깝다”고 했다.)

He added, “At that time, I was fully committed to the case of the Paldal Police Station detention in Suwon, and it was an event attended by key figures of the then-ruling party, so I needed to strongly emphasize the necessity of securing a budget to the attendees. It’s true that I got angry in the moment because preparations weren’t done, but describing it as an assault seems somewhat different from the actual facts.” (그는 “그때 워낙 제가 (수원) 팔달경찰서 유치와 관련해 전력을 다해서 노력할 때고, 당시 여당의 실세들이 참석하는 행사여서 예산 확보를 위해 참석자들에게 필요성을 강력하게 어필할 필요가 있었다”며 “그래서 순간적으로 준비가 안 돼 있어서 화를 냈던 건 틀림없는 사실인데, 그걸 폭행했다고 표현하는 건 다소간 사실 관계에 좀 차이가 있는 것 같다”고 했다.)

Kim’s campaign issued a statement on behalf of all staff and volunteers, saying, “We have been with the candidate from as recently as a few days ago to as far back as 12 years ago. During that time, none of us has experienced or witnessed any violence, abusive language, or intimidating behavior from the candidate as described in the report. This is what we actually experience every day.” (김 후보 캠프는 이날 실무진·자원봉사자 일동 명의로 낸 입장문에서 “저희는 가깝게는 며칠 전부터, 길게는 12년 전부터 후보와 함께해 왔다”며 “그 기간에 누구도 보도에서 묘사된 것과 같은 폭력이나 막말, 위압적 언행을 후보에게서 겪거나 목격한 사실이 없다. 이것은 저희가 매일 실제로 경험하고 있는 사실”이라고 했다.)

Kang Jun-hyun, the senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, said at a press briefing on the same day regarding the allegations against Kim, “We should avoid election campaign tactics that are like ‘guilty until proven innocent’ negative campaigning or a ‘shoot first, ask later’ approach.” (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 기자간담회에서 김 후보 의혹에 대해 “아니면 말고 식의 네거티브, 일단 질러놓고 보자는 식의 선거운동 방식은 지양해야 한다”고 했다.)
